stemMd: Which statement correctly describes the oxygen and light measurements in this profile?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Both decrease at every successive sampled depth

options.label: D
options.textMd: Both decrease by the same fixed amount at each2m step.

explanationMd: Every successive oxygen reading and every successive light reading is lower than the preceding one. This describes association in the sampled profile without identifying a cause.

distractorRationale.d: Neither series has a constant absolute decrement.
